Approach

Principles

Innovation without losing control.

New technology still needs clear ownership, security, documentation and support.

Practical first

Use technology because it solves a meaningful problem, not because it is new.

Human in the loop

Keep people, review and accountability in workflows where judgment matters.

Secure integration

Treat credentials, APIs, devices and data flows as part of the security boundary.

Supportable design

Prefer systems that can be monitored, documented and maintained after launch.
